doc_friction.issue: Step 0 sent me to queue alert #7 (risk_review.py), but the queue had 1,186 alerts that PR #18676 had already fixed. QUEUE.md on the branch did not yet name its scanned commit, and the shallow clone hid #18676 until git log on a file showed the graft. About 15 minutes went to false positives before the actions API showed main's CodeQL runs were all replaced while pending.

A full main analysis takes about 64 minutes (javascript) while merges arrive every few minutes, so only one push run had ever completed (run 11). The queue lags main by an hour or more. Making the javascript analysis faster would shorten the lag, but this session has no CodeQL CLI to measure a change.
Fixed in this PR: steps after a skipped actions/download-artifact (codeql gate, security-gate Verdict) were reported FAILED locally.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
